data.one_liner: Android implementation of the local_auth plugin for biometric authentication.
data.what_it_does: Provides Android-specific implementation for local_auth, allowing apps to authenticate users via biometrics or device credentials. Handles activity changes, permissions, and themes required for local authentication on Android.
use_when: You are using the local_auth package and need its Android implementation details setup.
You need to build Android-specific biometric authentication features into your Flutter application.
avoid_when: You are building a cross-platform app and should use the higher-level local_auth package instead of depending on this platform-specific package directly.
You are targeting non-Android platforms exclusively.
strengths: Endorsed and automatically included when using the main local_auth plugin.
Provides native integration with Android FragmentActivity and biometric APIs.
weaknesses: Requires manual Android setup like changing FlutterActivity to FlutterFragmentActivity and adding permissions.
data.setup_notes: Requires updating your AndroidManifest.xml to use FlutterFragmentActivity instead of FlutterActivity, adding the USE_BIOMETRIC permission, and updating your LaunchTheme's parent to a valid Theme.AppCompat theme.

alternatives.name: local_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: The top-level federated package that automatically includes this Android implementation along with other platforms.
